def factor_herding_dm_ewm_confirmed(df):
    """Volume-weighted close position within 20-day range, attenuated by exponential-smoothed directional-movement imbalance."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy['high']
    low = df_copy['low']
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']

    high_roll = high.rolling(20, min_periods=20).max()
    low_roll = low.rolling(20, min_periods=20).min()
    range_ = high_roll - low_roll
    position = (close - low_roll) / range_.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_sum = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    weighted_pos = (volume * position).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / vol_sum.replace(0, np.nan)
    herding = 2 * weighted_pos - 1

    up_move = high.diff()
    down_move = -low.diff()
    plus_dm = np.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), up_move, 0.0)
    minus_dm = np.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), down_move, 0.0)
    plus_ewm = pd.Series(plus_dm, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=60, adjust=False).mean()
    minus_ewm = pd.Series(minus_dm, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=60, adjust=False).mean()
    dm_total = plus_ewm + minus_ewm
    dm_imbalance = (plus_ewm - minus_ewm) / dm_total.replace(0, np.nan)
    dm_imbalance = dm_imbalance.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

    weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * dm_imbalance.clip(-1, 1)
    factor = herding * weight
    return factor.rename('factor_herding_dm_ewm_confirmed')
